changes.title: Server code that checks "Work Order Lines — Create & Edit" directly changed
changes.risk_reason: A handler/voter reads this permission directly; its enforcement moved.
qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call the affected endpoint(s) as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Work Order Lines — Create & Edit" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.
